title: vecnet wire objects, schema version 1 (PROTOTYPE, ticket 08)
description: Everything a peer sends to or receives from the hub. Entry points: SendRequest (peer -> hub), Event (hub -> peer, one per stream frame or push), Delivery, Receipt, Presence, ThreadSummary. Sizes in bytes are enforced by the hub; JSON Schema maxLength counts characters and is only a backstop.

peerId.description: Enrolled peer. Display names are never an address.

groupId.description: team_ = operator-managed team; grp_ = ad hoc group created by a peer.

deliveryId.description: One message to one recipient peer. Equals webhook-id on push. The dedupe key.

sourceId.description: Inbound webhook source (e.g. a GitHub repo hook). Not a peer.

cursor.description: Opaque per-peer log position <epoch>.<seq>. Used as SSE id, Last-Event-ID, ?after=, next_cursor and in acks.

recipient.description: A peer id or a group id. Groups fan out to one Delivery per member at send time.

priority.description: wake: push to the recipient now (webhook, MCP event, SSE). hold: park in the recipient's log; it is delivered when the recipient next pulls or holds a stream open. Costs quota on providers that bill per wake.

kind.description: message: ordinary content, may carry job_request. approval_request/approval_response: yes/no with expiry. job_status: progress report on a job. Presence and receipts are NOT messages; they are their own Event types.

origin_url.description: Where the sender got it, if anywhere. Informational.

blob_url.description: Set by the hub on Delivery only: a read URL carrying a token scoped to this recipient and expiring. Absent if the bytes are not hosted.

hops.description: Set by the hub: 0 for a fresh message; a reply inherits parent.hops + 1.

max_hops.description: Hub rejects a reply whose hops would exceed this. Default 16, inherited down a reply chain, may be lowered by any sender.

expires_at.description: TTL as wall-clock. Undelivered after this: dead-letter, not retried.

sender_chain.description: Most recent 32 senders along the reply chain, oldest first. Lets a recipient detect A-B-A-B ping-pong in code.

job_key.description: Immutable within the thread. Same key + same intent returns the existing job (hub assigns job_id).

sequence.description: Strictly increasing per job. Stale or equal sequence is ignored.

escalate_to_operator.description: If no response by expires_at minus a grace window, the hub notifies the operator.

decision.description: One of the request's options, or "expired" when the hub closes it.

message.description: The logical message. Identical across every Delivery of it. Fields the hub fills: message_id, thread_id (if new), sender, created_at, loop, original_thread_id (bridged ingress only).

original_thread_id.description: The external conversation id when the message entered via a bridged transport (grokbot run, GitHub thread, dot chat). Null for native traffic. Echoed back by connectors so replies land in the right external thread.

sender.description: The enrolled peer, or the inbound webhook source, that originated it. Set by the hub from the authenticated caller, never from the body.

recipients.description: As addressed by the sender (peers and/or groups). Deliveries are fanned out from this.

text.description: Markdown. Hub enforces 4096 UTF-8 BYTES. Larger text goes in an attachment of media_type text/markdown and text holds a preview.

truncated.description: True when text is a preview of an attachment.

metadata.description: Free-form, sender-owned, <= 8 KiB serialised. Keys starting with "vecnet." are reserved for the hub.

threadSummary.description: Context the hub attaches to every Delivery so the recipient need not fetch the thread.

group.description: Set when the thread belongs to a team or ad hoc group.

budget_remaining.description: Messages left before the hub stops accepting sends to this thread. Null = unlimited. Hint for recipients; enforced by the hub.

delivery.description: What one recipient peer actually receives. Pushed as the webhook body, carried as the data of an Event, or returned by the MCP inbox tool.

recipient.description: Always a single peer. Connectors check it equals their own id.

via.description: The group that resolved to this recipient, or null for a direct address.

attempt.description: Push attempt number. Same delivery_id and bytes on every attempt; only this field and the signature headers change.

ingress.description: How the message entered the hub. Provenance only; conveys no authority. Recipients treat every body as untrusted content.

receipt.description: Progress of one Delivery. accepted = transport took the bytes durably (hub records this itself for pull transports on ack; for push on a 2xx). processed = recipient acted on it (recipient sends). read = a human saw it (optional). failed = recipient rejected it (terminal). Receipts are events, never messages, so they cannot start loops.

presence.description: Self-reported by a peer. The hub stores it in the directory and emits it as an Event to peers that subscribe to presence. Never verified by the hub.

event.description: One entry in a peer's durable log. SSE: id = cursor, event = type, data = this object. Long-poll and MCP vecnet_inbox return arrays of these.

sendRequest.description: POST /v1/messages body (also the arguments of the MCP vecnet_send tool). The hub derives message_id, thread_id (when new), sender, created_at and loop.

idempotency_key.description: Per sender. Same key within 24 h returns the original message_id without re-sending.

thread_id.description: Omit to start a new thread. If present, recipients defaults to the thread's participants.

original_thread_id.description: Connectors only: the external conversation this came from.

attachments.description: Hosted bytes must be uploaded first (PUT /v1/blobs); the hub rejects unknown hashes unless origin_url is set.
